message:
Blog post slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including the previously failing one.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes the title (NFD) and strips the combining accent marks before calling slugify. I left `vendor/slugify` alone because its header and `vendor/README.md` say not to edit it by hand.

The shop's `src/shop/product-url.js` also calls the same vendored slugify, so product names with accents will still drop those letters. I didn't change it because you asked about blog posts. If you want shop URLs fixed too, the same one-line normalization would go there.
